descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S11 Existing spec: a Hospital summary failure keeps the note, shows the error and a retry, and survives a reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient; ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes fails once at the Convex socket (action-observer failFirst)

When Type a note, Save Note, then reload and reopen the editor

Then 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated' shows, the text is still in the box, Save Note is offered; after reload the persisted 'needs another attempt' message and the text are still there

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Hospital only; it does not check that Generate is disabled or that a retry then succeeds: both modes with the Generate gate and the retry are S26 (live fault) and S12 (seeded day 2)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S11

Existing spec: a Hospital summary failure keeps the note, shows the error and a retry, and survives a reload

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-10.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — a structured-summary failure keeps the reviewed note and a visible retry — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec e2e/chart.spec.ts, chromium): it makes a fresh @roundai.test account with the local admin key and fails ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes with action-observer failFirst; dev has no admin key and no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
